status.title: Account status
status.readOnly: The account is read-only: you can view and export, but not create or edit.

explain.TRIAL: You are on the free trial, with every feature unlocked.
explain.ACTIVE: Your subscription is active. Everything is working normally.
explain.PAST_DUE: A payment is due. Settle it before the deadline to avoid paused access.
explain.SUSPENDED: Access is paused. Your data is still stored and can be exported.
explain.CANCELLED: The account was cancelled. Export your data before the final deadline.

trial.unit: {days, plural, one {trial day left} other {trial days left}}

export.title: Export your data
export.body: Download the company's reports and spreadsheets at any time.
export.bodyDeadline: Download the company's reports and spreadsheets by {date}. After that, the data will be deleted.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.needsAcceptance: The terms were updated to version {version}. Read and accept them to continue.

cancel.sectionBody: If you cancel, the account becomes read-only and you get a deadline to export your data.
cancel.title: Cancel the company account?
cancel.description: You cannot undo this yourself. Here is what happens:
cancel.mismatch: The name does not match. Type it exactly as shown above.

consequences.readOnly: No one will be able to create or edit records.
consequences.export: You can still view and export the data for 90 days.
consequences.purge: After the deadline, all of the company's data and photos will be deleted.
